ranked_remaining.surface: List Pattern manual picker start/cancel injection lacks exact document target
source_proof: src/features/showcase/tabs/ListPatternTab.tsx:361-379 admits enterPicker from a ready pageKey and later calls startListPickerSession(tabId, sessionId, seed).
src/lib/data-pattern/list-picker-session.ts:35-56 performs both script installation and picker start with target { tabId }, without the captured documentId or a post-injection identity check.

The relay at src/lib/data-pattern/list-picker-relay.ts stamps tab_id only. ListPatternTab's fromOurPick guard at :180-188 correctly rejects a result unless the original pageKey is still current, so source supports a wrong-document picker target window but not an admitted stale result.
ranked_remaining.reproducible_async_sequence: On document A, begin a List Pattern pick and hold the first script injection between installation and start; same-URL reload the tab to document B; let the queued start execute; observe the picker target, then select a list. The source predicts injection targets whichever document is current at each tab-only call; the result should fail current-page admission after B resolves. This is a source-derived sequence, not a runtime claim.
ranked_remaining.required_fix: Capture the ready documentId with the picker session; target both install/start/cancel to that document and reject start if the shared pageKey has changed. Stamp trusted sender.documentId on picker relay and require it to match the session document before accepting events, while retaining session_id and pageKey guards. Provide explicit retry/remedy if exact-document injection fails.
ranked_remaining.qualification: Result admission is guarded; the missing contract is exact document targeting and preventing a delayed A action from operating on B. Verify runtime ordering before claiming a user-visible failure.
